Energy Drain

Darth Nihilus (Star Wars) can drain energy to maintain his hunger & power. He can feed on entire planets.

Power/Ability to:

Drain energy from individuals or objects.
"Mmmmm...Your life energy has a deep woodsy flavor, with just a hint of sage and no bitter aftertaste. Four stars! I'll have to recommend dining on you to all my fiendish friends."
― Sabine to Roy Greenhilt as she drains his life energy. (The Order of the Stick)

The power to leech off energy from an object, creature, or existing energy. Variation of Energy Absorption and Vampiric Draining.

Also Called[]

  • Energy Depletion/Draining/Extraction/Hunger/Leech/Siphoning
  • Force Drain (Star Wars)
  • Level Depletion/Extraction/Hunger/Leech/Drain/Siphoning
  • Life Depletion/Hunger/Leech

Capabilities[]

Users can drain energy from individuals or objects. They can drain physical energy from a target or group, making the affected physically weaker or causing them extreme fatigue while gaining their strength and stamina, even to the point of death.

Applications[]

  • Life-Force Absorption
    • Death Inducement
    • Stamina Absorption
    • Strength Absorption
  • Enhanced Condition or Supernatural Condition
  • Energy Dilution
  • Power Absorption

Variations[]

  • Draining Field Projection
  • Draining Vision
  • Psionic Drain
  • Health Drain

Associations[]

  • Absorption
  • Ambient Energy Manipulation
  • Energy Absorption
  • Element Drain
  • Energy Scattering
  • Enervation Inducement
  • Fatigue Manipulation
  • Incapacitation Inducement
  • Total Drain
  • Vampiric Draining

Limitations[]

  • May be constantly active.
  • Users of Energy Independence are immune.
  • Cannot use drained energy for more intricate manners that are available in Energy Absorption.
    • Also, the user will simply drain energy, it doesn't mean they can replenish their health and their own energy, and increase their powers and abilities when doing the process.
  • Infinite Energy

Gallery[]

Anime/Manga/Aeni/Manhwa[]

Android 19 (Dragon Ball Z) draining Goku's life energy directly with the pad on his palm.
Wasp Spider (Kanokon) draining Chizuru Minamoto of her energy, nearly to the point where she died.
Orb (Marchen Awakens Romance) has the ability to drain magical power from others upon contact.
Rolan's (Marchen Awakens Romance) Nature ÄRM, Dark Ribbon wraps his enemy in throned rose roots and drains their magical power.
Hamelin (Marchen Awakens Romance) uses the Darkness ÄRM, Soul Flute to summon the said instrument and then plays a tune to drain the magic from anyone who hears the melody.
Saturn's (Marchen Awakens Romance) Darkness ÄRM, Finsternis casts a curse that not only paralyzes his enemy, but gradually eats away at their magical power.
Ian (Marchen Awakens Romance) uses his Darkness ÄRM, Demonic Bond to drain his enemy's magical power and liquify it through a chain. Consequently, Ian's own magical power diminishes as well.
Unlike a true ÄRM which chooses to be partners with its master, Ghost ÄRMs (Marchen Awakens Romance) gradually eat away at the user's energy.
After fighting Kaidou for a long period of time, Monkey D. Luffy's (One Piece) Gear 5 wears off, possibly draining him of his Haki.
Aside from accelerating plant growth, the energy waves emitted by Final Mova (Sonic X) drain the life force from all non-plant life forms...
...like so.
The Metarexes (Sonic X) locked Leon and the other Resistance soldiers into a tree, then they were growing together with and consumed by a tree and died.
Ban (Nanatsu no Taizai/The Seven Deadly Sins) using Physical Hunt.
Suhyeon Kim (QUESTISM) using Mana Drain to absorb his opponent's stats.
